projects.title: Simple Tracking
projects.summary: A calorie tracker for logging meals and checking daily progress.
projects.description: A lightweight interface for keeping track of food and a daily calorie goal. This demonstration uses sample data so the core interaction can be explored without an account.
projects.alt: Illustration of a calorie tracking interface with a daily overview and meal entries.
projects.disclosure: This is an adapted demonstration of a personal project. The data in the demo is illustrative.

projects.title: Restaurant website
projects.summary: A restaurant website with food photography, a menu and a booking interface.
projects.description: An early restaurant website centred on photography, menu presentation and a booking interface. The original content has been adapted for this portfolio.
projects.alt: Reconstructed preview: adapted restaurant website with food photography and a dark red accent.
projects.disclosure: Archived work. This visual is a reconstruction of the original layout with adapted names and content.

projects.title: Casting directory
projects.summary: An interface for finding people and opportunities in a casting catalogue.
projects.description: An early web interface for a casting catalogue, with search, filtering and profile-oriented layouts. The presentation has been anonymised and adapted.
projects.alt: Reconstructed preview: adapted casting platform interface with a search panel and profile cards.
projects.disclosure: Archived work. This visual is a reconstruction of the original layout with adapted names and content.

projects.title: Safety systems
projects.summary: A structured landing page for presenting safety and security services.
projects.description: An early website for fire and security systems, using a bold visual grid to organise services. The presentation has been anonymised and adapted.
projects.alt: Reconstructed preview: adapted safety systems website with a geometric grid and red accents.
projects.disclosure: Archived work. This visual is a reconstruction of the original layout with adapted names and content.

projects.title: Trading interface
projects.summary: An account interface for browsing offers and reviewing transactions.
projects.description: A selection of frontend screens for a larger financial product. This view presents a trading catalogue with filters and account navigation. The visual has been adapted with neutral branding and sample data.
projects.alt: Adapted trading interface with sample offers and account navigation.
projects.disclosure: Archived work: selected interface implementation, presented with anonymised branding and illustrative data.
